001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
009import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
010import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStream;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Performance optimization examples for StreamConverter.
019 *
020 * <p>This class demonstrates: - Memory-efficient processing techniques - Concurrent pipeline
021 * optimization - Large dataset handling - Performance monitoring
022 */
023public class PerformanceOptimizationExamples {
024
025  private static final Logger logger =
026      LoggerFactory.getLogger(PerformanceOptimizationExamples.class);
027
028  /**
029   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。パフォーマンス最適化の例を実行します。
030   *
031   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
032   */
033  public static void main(String[] args) {
034    logger.info("⚡ StreamConverter - Performance Optimization Examples");
035    logger.info("=====================================================\n");
036
037    try {
038      // Example 1: Large dataset processing
039      largeDatasetProcessing();
040
041      // Example 2: Concurrent pipeline optimization
042      concurrentPipelineOptimization();
043
044      // Example 3: Memory-efficient processing
045      memoryEfficientProcessing();
046
047      // Example 4: Performance monitoring
048      performanceMonitoring();
049
050    } catch (Exception e) {
051      logger.error("Performance example failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
052    }
053  }
054
055  /** Example 1: Processing large datasets efficiently */
056  private static void largeDatasetProcessing() throws IOException {
057    logger.info("📊 Large Dataset Processing");
058    logger.info("============================");
059
060    // Generate large CSV dataset
061    StringBuilder largeDataset = new StringBuilder();
062    largeDataset.append("id,name,value,timestamp\n");
063
064    for (int i = 1; i <= 10000; i++) {
065      largeDataset.append(
066          String.format(
067              "%d,Item%d,%.2f,2023-07-15T%02d:%02d:%02d\n",
068              i, i, Math.random() * 1000, (i % 24), (i % 60), (i % 60)));
069    }
070
071    long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
072
073    // Process large dataset with memory-efficient navigation
074    logger.info("🔄 Processing 10,000 records...");
075    processDataWithTiming(
076        largeDataset.toString(), CsvNavigateCommand.create("name", new PassThroughRule()));
077
078    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
079    logger.info(String.format("⏱️ Processing completed in %d ms", endTime - startTime));
080
081    // Show memory usage
082    Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
083    long memoryUsed = runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
084    logger.info(String.format("💾 Memory used: %.2f MB", memoryUsed / (1024.0 * 1024.0)));
085
086    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
087  }
088
089  /** Example 2: Concurrent pipeline optimization */
090  private static void concurrentPipelineOptimization() throws IOException {
091    logger.info("🔗 Concurrent Pipeline Optimization");
092    logger.info("====================================");
093
094    String jsonData = generateLargeJsonData();
095
096    // Single command processing
097    long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
098    logger.info("🔄 Single command processing...");
099    processDataWithTiming(jsonData, JsonNavigateCommand.createForAll(new PassThroughRule()));
100    long singleTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
101
102    // Pipeline processing (demonstrates concurrent execution)
103    startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
104    logger.info("\n🔄 Pipeline processing (concurrent)...");
105    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
106      JsonNavigateCommand.createForAll(new PassThroughRule()),
107      new SampleStreamCommand("stage1"),
108      new SampleStreamCommand("stage2")
109    };
110    processDataWithTiming(jsonData, pipeline);
111    long pipelineTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
112
113    logger.info(String.format("📈 Performance comparison:"));
114    logger.info(String.format("  Single command: %d ms", singleTime));
115    logger.info(String.format("  Pipeline: %d ms", pipelineTime));
116    logger.info(
117        String.format("  CPU cores utilized: %d", Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors()));
118
119    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
120  }
121
122  /** Example 3: Memory-efficient processing demonstration */
123  private static void memoryEfficientProcessing() throws IOException {
124    logger.info("💾 Memory-Efficient Processing");
125    logger.info("===============================");
126
127    // Generate data that would be problematic for memory
128    StringBuilder hugeDataset = new StringBuilder();
129    hugeDataset.append("id,data\n");
130
131    for (int i = 1; i <= 50000; i++) {
132      hugeDataset.append(String.format("%d,%s\n", i, "x".repeat(100))); // 100-char string per row
133    }
134
135    long beforeMemory = getUsedMemory();
136
137    logger.info("🔄 Processing 50,000 records with 100-char data each...");
138    processDataWithTiming(
139        hugeDataset.toString(), CsvNavigateCommand.create("id", new PassThroughRule()));
140
141    long afterMemory = getUsedMemory();
142    long memoryIncrease = afterMemory - beforeMemory;
143
144    logger.info(String.format("💾 Memory increase: %.2f MB", memoryIncrease / (1024.0 * 1024.0)));
145    logger.info("✅ Demonstrates streaming processing with constant memory usage");
146
147    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
148  }
149
150  /** Example 4: Performance monitoring and optimization */
151  private static void performanceMonitoring() throws IOException {
152    logger.info("📊 Performance Monitoring");
153    logger.info("==========================");
154
155    String testData = generateTestData();
156
157    // Test different processing strategies
158    logger.info("🧪 Testing different processing strategies:\n");
159
160    // Strategy 1: Direct processing
161    long start = System.nanoTime();
162    processDataWithTiming(testData, CsvNavigateCommand.create("name", new PassThroughRule()));
163    long directTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
164
165    // Strategy 2: Pipeline processing
166    start = System.nanoTime();
167    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
168      CsvNavigateCommand.create("name", new PassThroughRule()), new SampleStreamCommand("processor")
169    };
170    processDataWithTiming(testData, pipeline);
171    long pipelineTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
172
173    // Strategy 3: Multi-stage processing
174    start = System.nanoTime();
175    IStreamCommand[] multiStage = {
176      CsvNavigateCommand.create("name", new PassThroughRule()),
177      new SampleStreamCommand("stage1"),
178      new SampleStreamCommand("stage2"),
179      new SampleStreamCommand("stage3")
180    };
181    processDataWithTiming(testData, multiStage);
182    long multiStageTime = System.nanoTime() - start;
183
184    // Performance analysis
185    logger.info("\n📈 Performance Analysis:");
186    logger.info(String.format("  Direct processing: %.2f ms", directTime / 1_000_000.0));
187    logger.info(String.format("  Pipeline processing: %.2f ms", pipelineTime / 1_000_000.0));
188    logger.info(String.format("  Multi-stage processing: %.2f ms", multiStageTime / 1_000_000.0));
189
190    double throughput = (testData.length() * 1000.0) / (directTime / 1_000_000.0);
191    logger.info(String.format("  Throughput: %.2f MB/s", throughput / (1024.0 * 1024.0)));
192
193    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
194  }
195
196  /** Helper method to process data with timing */
197  private static void processDataWithTiming(String inputData, IStreamCommand command)
198      throws IOException {
199    processDataWithTiming(inputData, new IStreamCommand[] {command});
200  }
201
202  /** Helper method to process data with timing for pipelines */
203  private static void processDataWithTiming(String inputData, IStreamCommand[] commands)
204      throws IOException {
205    try (InputStream inputStream =
206            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
207        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
208
209      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
210      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
211
212      // Show only a sample of output for large datasets
213      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
214      String[] lines = result.split("\n");
215
216      if (lines.length > 10) {
217        logger.info("Sample output (first 5 lines):");
218        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(5, lines.length); i++) {
219          logger.info(lines[i]);
220        }
221        logger.info("... (" + (lines.length - 5) + " more lines)");
222      } else {
223        logger.info("Output:");
224        logger.info(result.trim());
225      }
226    }
227  }
228
229  /** Generate large JSON data for testing */
230  private static String generateLargeJsonData() {
231    StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder();
232    json.append("{\"data\":[");
233
234    for (int i = 1; i <= 1000; i++) {
235      if (i > 1) json.append(",");
236      json.append(
237          String.format(
238              "{\"id\":%d,\"name\":\"Item%d\",\"value\":%.2f,\"active\":%s}",
239              i, i, Math.random() * 1000, (i % 2 == 0) ? "true" : "false"));
240    }
241
242    json.append("],\"total\":1000}");
243    return json.toString();
244  }
245
246  /** Generate test data for performance monitoring */
247  private static String generateTestData() {
248    StringBuilder data = new StringBuilder();
249    data.append("id,name,category,price\n");
250
251    for (int i = 1; i <= 5000; i++) {
252      data.append(
253          String.format("%d,Product%d,Category%d,%.2f\n", i, i, (i % 10) + 1, Math.random() * 100));
254    }
255
256    return data.toString();
257  }
258
259  /** Get current memory usage */
260  private static long getUsedMemory() {
261    Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
262    return runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
263  }
264}
